category_description: Turnkey engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) of electrical substations and modular secondary package substations.

products.description: Comprehensive turnkey EPC electrical substation solutions executed on a single-source responsibility basis from conceptual design up to 400 kV.

specifications.execution_voltage_range: Turnkey basis up to 400 kV (typical layouts for 33 kV, 66 kV, 132 kV, 220 kV, 400 kV)
scope_of_equipment: Outdoor Circuit Breakers (SF6 and Vacuum VCB)
Zinc Oxide Lightning and Surge Arrestors
Current Transformers (CT), Potential Transformers (PT), and CVTs
ACSR / AAAC Busbar Conductors, Hardware, and Clamps
Medium Voltage and Low Voltage Control Panels
Numerical Protective Relay Panels and SCADA Power Management Systems
Station Battery Banks, DC Float-cum-Boost Chargers
HT Capacitor Banks and Harmonic Filter Systems

services_offered: System study, load flow, and short-circuit fault analysis
Civil, structural, and electrical architectural design
Project scheduling, procurement, and site construction supervision
Testing, relay coordination, calibration, and statutory grid synchronization
unverified_fields: Specific warranty period for turnkey civil civil structures

products.description: Prefabricated outdoor package substations integrating an MV switchgear compartment, an oil-immersed or cast resin transformer, and an LV switchboard into a compact weatherproof housing.

specifications.capacity_range: Houses distribution transformers up to 1250 kVA / 24 kV (standard packages: 110 kVA, 250 kVA, 500 kVA, 1 MVA, 1.25 MVA)
specifications.enclosure_protection: Standard IP23D (meets IP53/IP23, optional IP54 doors with specialized perimeter gaskets)
specifications.mv_switchgear_unit: ABB SafeRing / SafePlus SF6 Gas-Insulated Ring Main Unit (RMU) in sealed stainless steel tank

features: Fully segregated internal compartments prevent accidental touch of live parts
Compact footprint ideal for high-density urban zones and space-constrained industrial sites
Pre-wired, factory tested, and delivered ready for immediate site commissioning
applications: Industrial estates and solar park collection points
